item.title: UpToDay Crypto — 10 November 2025
item.description: ## Stories & Sources - 1. Coinbase launches public token sales platform; Monad first issuer — https://www.theblock.co/post/378177/coinbase-public-token-sales-ico-platform-monad-first?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss - 3. IRS issues guidance to allow ETPs to stake assets — https://www.theblock.co/post/378247/irs-issues-guidance-allowing-crypto-etps-stake-digital-assets?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss - 4. BitMine's ETH holdings surpass 3.5M, hitting 2.9% of supply — https://www.theblock.co/post/378217/bitmines-share-of-ethereum-supply-hits-2-9-as-firms-eth-holdings-pass-3-5-million?utm_source=rss&utm_medium=rss - 5. Strategy raises $715M in Europe to buy more Bitcoin — https://decrypt.co/347825/strategy-raises-715-million-europe-buy-bitcoin _Not financial advice..._
